content: Many of the talks from this meeting seem interesting. Are they available online somewhere?
David said here that the talks from Friday will be available online, so I'd guess talks from Wed/Thu will also be available

I'm afraid we only recorded the talks on the last day (when we had a larger audience because it coincided with the Swiss Math Soc AGM, & hence we scheduled more general-interest talks). Here is the link: https://tube.switch.ch/collections/66CerlbmQD

The more specialized talks on the first two days weren't recorded, but I am sure the speakers would be happy to share their slides – I think virtually all of them are on this zulip.
